name: update-path
about: LIVE post-publish update check (setup's params plus next_version/next_sequence): install release N, join, and let the real channel offer, stage and flip to release N+1. Learned live: a staged release flips at the NEXT launcher boot, so after the restart (reopen) the installed launcher reports the new version and state.json goes idle with pinned_sequence = the new sequence. Same WRITE-ONLY rules as setup.

params.next_version: the version the channel's newer release reports, e.g. 0.1.0+e4f222bd

steps.say: U1 the channel's newer release is staged
argv: i=0; while [ $i -lt 180 ]; do grep -Eq '"phase":\s*"staged"' "$0" && grep -Eq '"(sequence|pinned_sequence)":\s*{param:next_sequence}\b' "$0" && exit 0; i=$((i+1)); sleep 5; done; cat "$0"; exit 1

steps.say: open the Settings tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Settings tab is selected and its Updates section shows a Ready to install row naming {param:next_version} with a Restart to update button; no failure state (status notes are states, not errors)

steps.say: U3 the installed launcher is now the newer release
U3 the flipped release qualified: idle and pinned to the newer sequence
argv: i=0; while [ $i -lt 60 ]; do grep -Eq '"phase":\s*"idle"' "$0" && grep -Eq '"pinned_sequence":\s*{param:next_sequence}\b' "$0" && exit 0; i=$((i+1)); sleep 5; done; cat "$0"; exit 1
